title: Rite of incubation in the giants' tombs

tellings.quote: those tombs, it's known to the archaeological community, were configured in such a way so that they could accommodate what's called the right of incubation

plain: The giants' tombs of Sardinia, ancient stone tombs on the Italian island, were supposedly built to make room for a ritual called the rite of incubation, in which people slept in a sacred place hoping to receive a dream or vision. A researcher named Tim Alberino, who has visited the sites, tells Michels this and says 'it's known to the archaeological community,' though he names no source. If true, the tombs were places of ritual as well as burial.
